packageRules.description: @cloudflare/next-on-pages only supports next <= 15.5.2, so stay on the patched 15.4 line.
typescript-eslint supports TypeScript < 6.1 only, and TypeScript 7 has no JavaScript API for the Next.js 15 type check.
eslint-plugin-react and eslint-plugin-import do not support ESLint 10 yet.
